strings.ui_cast_hint_connected: Connected — select a video, song, or photo on your phone
strings.ui_cast_hint_idle: Cast content from your phone to this PC
strings.ui_cast_hint_step1: ① Connect your phone to the same Wi-Fi network as this PC
strings.ui_cast_hint_step2: ② Tap Cast or Mirror in your phone's gallery or video app
strings.ui_cast_hint_step3: ③ Select this PC in the device list
strings.ui_cast_hint_apps: Any DLNA-capable app works, such as the built-in gallery or BubbleUPnP
strings.ui_close_dialog_text: Closing the window will end this cast and disconnect your phone. Close anyway?
strings.ui_settings_language_desc: The language used by the interface. Follow system matches Windows.
strings.ui_settings_theme_desc: Whether the interface is light or dark. Follow system matches Windows.
strings.ui_settings_accept_desc: When off, this PC disappears from the device list on your phone (equivalent to Do Not Disturb).
strings.ui_settings_broadcast_desc: Announces this device on the network at intervals. When off, your phone can still find it by searching.
strings.ui_settings_interval_desc: Shorter intervals are easier to find but add network traffic. If your phone cannot find this PC, try a shorter interval.
strings.ui_about_device_name_desc: The name shown in the device list when casting (matches the computer name).
strings.ui_about_device_address_desc: Control points reach this device at this address. On the same network you can open it in a phone browser to view the device description.
strings.ui_about_device_id_desc: Control points use it to tell whether this is the same device. It never changes once created.
